# Khalid Abuhakmeh

> Practical, tested guides for .NET developers: C#, ASP.NET Core, Blazor, HTMX, Entity Framework Core, NuGet, and developer tooling. Written by Khalid Abuhakmeh, sharing what he learns from more than a decade of building for the web.

Each post line is `- [Title](url): date | tags | description`, newest first. Dates are the last update (or publish) date.
